title: fix(plugin-auth)!: invite-member refuses a blank role 400 ROLE_NOT_FOUND and writes no invitation
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9DaM83BgA4HT94MMubC7A8L)_
Fixes #29158

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — measured: on base `104cd1a5` a blank role (`""`, whitespace only) on `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member` answered 200 and stored the invitation, in single and walled `group`; on this head it is refused 400 `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` and no row is written. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: none — measured: no schema key, accepted metadata value or metadata type moves; the diff touches no `packages/spec/**`.
Skills-docs: none — the narrowing is an HTTP door's accept set, not anything a metadata author writes; no skill names a blank invitation role.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：邀请成员接口遇到空角色（空串、纯空格、或角色列表里的空项）时直接拒绝，返回 400 ROLE_NOT_FOUND，不写邀请记录。
- 为什么改：以前空角色会被放行并存下一条角色为空的邀请；在多组织部署里被邀请人接受后成了没有组织角色的成员，读不到该读的数据，管理员也看不出原因。
- 风险与回滚：只拒不放宽，也不会把空角色默认成 member；已存在的空角色邀请不改动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts`（beforeCreateInvitation 新增的拒绝分支），`invite-role-not-found-code.ts`（判空与文案）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/accept-invitation-adopt-membership.test.ts`，预期 17 个全部通过，其中 7 个是新的空角色用例。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `beforeCreateInvitation` (`auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts`) refuses a blank role first, after the cloud-managed refusal and before the invitation role cap and the placement gate: `APIError('BAD_REQUEST', { code: 'ROLE_NOT_FOUND', message })`. The hook runs before `adapter.createInvitation`, so no `sys_invitation` row is written.
- `invite-role-not-found-code.ts` gains `hasBlankInvitationRoleEntry` and `blankInvitationRoleRefusal`. Blank means the whole value is empty or whitespace (`""`, `"   "`, `[]`) or one entry of a role list is (`"member,"`, `",admin"`, `["member", ""]`). The message keeps the vendor's `ROLE_NOT_FOUND: ` prefix and says the invitation role is empty.
- `invitation-role-cap.ts`: comment only. Its "not a reachable invitation shape" note on an empty role was false; it now points at the blank refusal that runs first.
- No new error code (the door's existing `ROLE_NOT_FOUND`), no `packages/spec/**` edit, no change to which non-blank roles are accepted, no default to `member`, no better-auth or overrides change.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/accept-invitation-adopt-membership.test.ts`: new `#29158` block on the real `AuthManager` and better-auth route. Six blank shapes are refused 400 `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` with the empty-role sentence and zero rows; a delegated admin's blank role answers `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` (not the cap's 403); control: the owner inviting `admin` is still 200 with the role stored.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/invitation-blank-role-refusal.dogfood.test.ts` (new): the composed CRM stack in `single` and walled `group` (`multiTenant: 'posture-only'`, the issuer owns a second organization). `""`, `"   "` and `"member,"` are refused 400 `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` with no row; control `member` is 200 with one pending row; a guard asserts the posture.
- No existing test needed an edit.

## Acceptance notes

- On the composed stack, `"member,"` (and `",admin"`) was ALREADY refused on base, by the `sys_invitation.role` select validator: 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` (`invalid_option`), no row. On this head the same request answers 400 `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` instead. Same status, same zero rows, a different code; only `""` and whitespace-only were accepted on base. Named in the report's open questions.
- Other doors that write `sys_invitation.role`: none found. `admin-import-users` writes the admin plugin's user role, never an invitation, and drops a blank one. The data API serves `sys_invitation` as `get`/`list` only. A resend (`resend: true`) of an already pending invitation renews its expiry and keeps the stored role, before this hook, so it writes no role; a resend with no pending row creates a new invitation and meets this refusal.
- Invitations already stored with a blank role are not rewritten; acceptance is not changed.

## Verification

<details><summary>Premise on base 104cd1a5 (both postures, composed stack)</summary>

The three gate files restored to base, plugin-auth rebuilt, a throwaway probe (not committed) on the CRM stack:

- single: `""` → 200, row `role: ''` pending; the invitee signs up and accepts → 200, `sys_member.role` `member` (the sign-up's row is kept), invitation `['', 'accepted']`. `"   "` → 200, row `role: '   '`. `"member,"` → 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`. `"superuser"` → 400 `ROLE_NOT_FOUND`.
- group: `""` → 200, row `role: ''`; accept → 200, `sys_member.role` `''`, invitation `['', 'accepted']`. `"   "` → 200. `"member,"` → 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`. `"superuser"` → 400 `ROLE_NOT_FOUND`.
- On base the new pins are red: unit 7 failed / 10 passed (17); dogfood 6 failed / 6 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation of the negative pins</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --anchor "if (blankRole) {" --replacement "if (blankRole && process.env.ABLATION_29158_GUARD === 'on') {"`, plugin-auth rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` saw the marker in 2 dist files. Unit: 7 failed / 10 passed (`expected 200 to be 400`, body `"role":""`). Dogfood: 6 failed / 4 passed, every blank case in both postures. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- …`: `git status --porcelain` empty, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, blob hash equal to HEAD, rebuilt, preflight `--absent`: marker absent from all 20 built files. A first attempt used a comment marker that the bundler strips; its preflight failed, so that reading was discarded and the run was redone with the string marker.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites, gates, lint (head 8d01f7cf, after merging main)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run`: Test Files 208 passed (208), Tests 3618 passed, 10 skipped.
- eslint (`--no-inline-config`) over `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` and the new dogfood file: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 65 derived, 65 run with exit 0, reconciled with `--ran`: "65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a DERIVED zero)". Two stopped at a prerequisite on the first pass and were rerun green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone, pinned fixture commit fetched) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (7 packages outside the closure built first).
- Full dogfood (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`): lock VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 390 passed, 3 skipped (393); Tests 3225 passed, 28 skipped (3253).
